introduction: CLEAR and Washington LawHelp offer routes to civil legal assistance and self-help information. Intake does not guarantee representation.
description: CLEAR and Washington LawHelp offer routes to civil legal assistance and self-help information. Intake does not guarantee representation.

sections.who: CLEAR screens eligible low-income applicants for civil legal problems. County and issue affect the appropriate referral.
sections.get: Help may include advice, referral or representation. Washington LawHelp offers legal information and forms.
sections.docs:
• Court papers and notices with deadlines.
  • Relevant correspondence and income details for screening.
sections.apply:
1. Identify the intake route

    Outside King County, call CLEAR at 888-201-1014, weekdays 9:15 a.m.–12:15 p.m. King County residents can start with 211.

  2. Explain the deadline

    State the issue, county and any hearing or response date.

  3. Use self-help resources

    Search Washington LawHelp while awaiting intake.
sections.after: Keep seeking timely help if intake cannot accept the case. A pending request does not extend a court deadline.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Washington courts legal-help routes; King County attorney resources; Washington LawHelp. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
